title: Equivalent fractions general rule
text: Recall that $$\frac{a}{b}=\frac{c}{d}$$ if and only if $$ad=bc$$

title: Equivalence decoded
text: Cross-multiplying, we find that $$\frac{3x-2}{x^2+1}=\frac{3}{7}$$ is equivalent to $$7(3x-2)=3\left(x^2+1\right)$$, assuming the denominators are never zero, which they are not here.
